main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of next-day return minus coin mean on close location
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope < 0 with t <= -2 (and top-fifth mean < 0); reject: slope > 0 with t >= +2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day return minus coin mean, close location >= 0.8

decided_by: The slope is negative with t <= -2 and the top-fifth mean is below 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Every bar is a case (1-bar horizon, so non-overlapping); the slope's t uses standard errors clustered by UTC day (residual x centred location summed per day, G/(G-1) correction); the situation holds where close location > 0, on the short side.

direction_check.why: main measure -0.001101 on the check folds against -0.006255 on every fold
